integrity: The mathematical proof is self-contained and uses finite Haar orthogonality and a subtree induction; executable exhaustive finite checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact noiseless measurements of the signed root sum and all individually labelled magnitudes of the finite nonperiodic dyadic Haar basis, with known two-symbol real alphabet. No claim for missing labels, arbitrary signals, or noisy reconstruction; bibliographic priority not independently certified.
title: Exact phaseless Haar fibers of binary dyadic signals and sharp fixed-weight ambiguity
